title: Claims Management and Coverage Counsel
location: New York, New York
posting_excerpt:
Coverage Counsel position reporting to our New York City Office.

This is a remote or hybrid position that may be based in any state where Wilson Elser has an office.

The Position

We are seeking an experienced Claims Management & Coverage Counsel to join our growing national team. This attorney will play a key role in providing sophisticated claims management, insurance coverage analysis, and strategic risk assessment across a broad range of specialty and professional liability lines.

In this role, you will independently manage complex claims and coverage matters from inception through resolution, partnering closely with clients, carriers, and outside counsel to develop effective litigation, settlement, and risk mitigation strategies. This position offers the opportunity to work on high-exposure, challenging matters while collaborating with a nationally recognized team of insurance professionals.

Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage a claims caseload, from claim notification through resolution.

- Evaluate coverage, liability and damages issues for complex professional liability, employment liability, real estate liability, miscellaneous liability and D&O matters.

- Draft reservation of rights and coverage denial letters

- Proactively monitor claims, prepare and develop handling and resolution strategies.

- Assign, coordinate, and manage outside counsel to obtain optimal resolutions.

- Prepare reports for clients with exposure analysis and reserve recommendations.

- Resolve claims through direct negotiations and participation in mediation.

- Work closely with other attorneys and Partners on legal projects.

- Ability to regularly interface with clients, carriers and outside counsel.

Qualifications

- JD from an accredited Law School

- Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction

- 5+ years of legal practice experience in the insurance area.

- Demonstrated experience handling complex insurance claims and evaluating coverage issues across professional and specialty liability lines.

- Experience drafting coverage opinions, reservation of rights letters, and coverage denial letters is strongly preferred.

- Prior experience in private practice, insurance coverage, or claims counseling is preferred.

- Superior written and oral communication skills required.

- Strong legal research and negotiation skills required.

- Ability to assess and interpret insurance policies, identify potential legal risks, and offer strategic solutions to prevent disputes from escalating.

- Strong organizational skills to effectively manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment.

Wilson Elser offers a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our attorneys both professionally and personally.

The Role

As a Senior Commercial Counsel you will play a central role in supporting one of the fastest-growing legal technology companies globally. You will work closely with our commercial teams, advising on a broad range of matters with a primary focus on drafting and negotiating commercial contracts.

This role requires a high degree of independence and the ability to operate across multiple time zones, partnering closely with stakeholders to enable deals while managing risk. 

Legora’s legal function is a forward-deployed, AI-first team working across multiple jurisdictions and legal disciplines. We act as trusted partners to the business, with particular focus on product development, operations, and commercial initiatives. Beyond strong legal judgment, we value curiosity, problem-solving, and a proactive mindset — looking for pragmatic solutions as we help redefine how legal work is done globally.

What You'll Do

 - Act as a commercial legal partner to the business, working closely with senior stakeholders in Growth, Operations, and Procurement on customer and supplier engagements.

 - Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of customer and supplier contracts, with a strong focus on closing deals efficiently and pragmatically.

 - Advise on commercial risk allocation, pricing structures, liability, and contractual protections within customer and supplier agreements.
   Support go-to-market and procurement activities by enabling scalable, repeatable commercial contracting practices.

 - Address data protection and compliance considerations primarily within the context of customer and supplier contracts, ensuring risks are appropriately managed without slowing execution.

 - Develop and maintain commercial templates, playbooks, and guidelines to standardise negotiations and improve deal velocity.

What You Bring

 - J.D. (or equivalent) with admission to practice in at least one U.S. state (or another common law jurisdiction).

 - 5+ years of experience at a top-tier law firm and/or as an in-house legal counsel.

 - Strong experience negotiating B2B SaaS agreements and supporting commercial
   teams. You’re an excellent negotiator.

 - Strong legal judgment and confidence in making decisions independently.

 - Experience in handling corporate matters and drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements.

 - Experience with data privacy matters, IT security and/or corporate law is a plus.

 - Your focus is on achieving meaningful business outcomes, translating into actionable advice delivered clearly and comprehensively.

 - You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic entrepreneurial environment and rapidly evolving business setting. You take initiative and are committed to delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working independently and can effectively manage work across different time zones.

 - You are excited about the potential of technology to transform the legal industry. You have a keen interest in AI and legal tech, and you are eager to learn and apply these tools in real-world settings.

What you’ll do

As Product and Privacy Counsel at Brex, you will be a critical strategic leader helping the company navigate the complex regulatory landscape at the intersection of financial services and technology. You will scale our privacy program and monitoring and assessment of legal and regulatory developments affecting Brex and its products. Together with cross-functional partners, you will be responsible for developing and scaling the privacy program, and providing strategic guidance that protects and advances Brex's business objectives. You will collaborate closely with internal teams, bank partners, and industry groups to ensure Brex maintains a robust, forward-looking approach to privacy. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

- Scale Data Privacy and Security Programs: Work with engineering and business teams to expand and enhance data security, access, and privacy programs, optimizing for Brex's evolving data landscape.

- Implement Global Privacy Compliance: Develop and implement processes for strict adherence to domestic and international privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), establishing monitoring and testing frameworks with the Compliance team.

- Negotiate Data-Related Contracts: Lead drafting and negotiation of external agreements, focusing on data protection, sharing, and data product legalities, safeguarding Brex's interests.
